# nut bios

Guide and verify BIOS recovery settings

```text
Guide and verify BIOS recovery settings

Usage: nut bios [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  guide
          Print a numbered keyboard walkthrough for this board
  setup
          Reboot into firmware setup after a hostname interlock
  attest
          Record a BIOS-version-pinned attestation receipt
  profile
          List, show, or scaffold a board profile

Options:
      --color <WHEN>
          Color output policy [default: auto] [possible values: auto, always, never]
      --ascii
          Use ASCII symbols and bars
  -j, --json
          Emit machine-readable JSON where supported
  -v, --verbose
          Include additional diagnostic detail
  -c, --config <PATH>
          Read host settings from this file
  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## nut bios profile

List, show, or scaffold a board profile

```text
List, show, or scaffold a board profile

Usage: nut bios profile [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  list
          List board profiles and mark the DMI match
  show
          Show one board profile by id
  new
          Print a starter board-profile TOML for this machine

Options:
      --color <WHEN>
          Color output policy [default: auto] [possible values: auto, always, never]
      --ascii
          Use ASCII symbols and bars
  -j, --json
          Emit machine-readable JSON where supported
  -v, --verbose
          Include additional diagnostic detail
  -c, --config <PATH>
          Read host settings from this file
  -h, --help
          Print help
```
